svg.text: THIS module: case, its own drawers / wheels, and scheduled doors.
Images show actual saved model geometry; exploded views are identification aids.
1. Build this nightstand's four-strip plinth, then case back, sides, Bottom and Top.
2. Fit its plywood L / C grip members between the solid side panels.
3. Build both drawers belonging to THIS nightstand; use their individual part IDs.
4. Fit selected 350 mm runners; dry-fit fronts and check the gaps and movement.
5. Keep this completed nightstand ready for final levelling / joining / anchoring.
